name: rafeqi
description: Rafeqi (رفيقي) — personal trainer and nutritionist for Egypt. Root scripts run everything.

scripts.setup: node scripts/setup-env.mjs && npm install && npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix tests/e2e install && npm --prefix tests/e2e run install-browser && uv --directory backend sync && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.dev: npm run db:migrate && concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm:dev:api" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.db:migrate: uv --directory backend run alembic upgrade head
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run typecheck && npm run test:e2e
